title: Windows terminals run on ConPTY pseudoconsoles the holder owns: ordered UTF-8 output, win32-input mode passthrough, resize and kill outside the input queue, and the exit only after the final output offset

declared_cases.summary: terminal.run launches a cmd.exe fixture on a ConPTY; the attach stream carries a UTF-8 marker and CSI ? 9001 h, the VT reports win32_input, terminal.resize reaches the program (mode con reports the new grid), a non-reading fixture whose input queue is full is killed through its job, and the exit arrives after output through its final_offset with zero processes left in the job and zero leaked handles.
terminal.run with rows 0 is invalid_geometry before any pseudoconsole is allocated; a missing program or directory is spawn_failed with nothing left running.
